question:
Deployment `kiosk` in namespace `kiosk` serves HTTP on TCP port `80`; its `metrics` sidecar listens on TCP `8081`. Restrict who can reach the kiosk Pods:

- Create NetworkPolicy `kiosk-ingress` in namespace `kiosk` that applies to the Pods of Deployment `kiosk` only.
- Allow ingress only from Pods labeled `role=monitor` that run in a namespace labeled `team=ops` (both conditions at once), and from any Pod in namespace `kiosk`.
- From either source only TCP port `80` may be reached; all other ingress to the kiosk Pods, including port `8081`, must be denied. Policies that already exist in `kiosk` must not allow more than this.
- Do not change any namespace or Pod labels.

Test from the Pods `monitor` and `guest` in namespaces `ops-east` and `ops-west` and from Pod `kiosk-client`, e.g. `kubectl -n ops-east exec monitor -- wget -qO- -T 2 http://<kiosk-pod-ip>`

verification.description: kiosk-ingress exists, has type Ingress and selects the kiosk Pods only (not kiosk-cache or kiosk-client)
all policies selecting the kiosk Pods together allow TCP 80 only from role=monitor in team=ops namespaces and from namespace kiosk, and never 8081 (Pod and namespace labels unchanged)
live: ops-east/monitor reaches kiosk:80, ops-east/guest and ops-west/monitor are blocked
live: kiosk-client reaches kiosk:80, port 8081 is blocked from kiosk-client and ops-east/monitor
